newsitem.title: USA: General Dynamics completes Lockheed unit buy.
newsitem.headline: General Dynamics completes Lockheed unit buy.

text.p: General Dynamics Corp said on Thursday it completed its purchase of the assets of Lockheed Martin Corp's Defense Systems and Lockheed Martin Armament Systems, effective January 1.
The 30-day waiting period set by the Hart Scott Rodino pre-merger notification act expired without action by the U.S. Department of Justice on December 19, the company said.
General Dynamics acquired the two units for $450 million, and assumed no debt in the transaction, it said.

Lockheed Martin Defense Systems, based in Pittsfield, Mass., has major product lines in the area of combat vehicles and Lockheed Martin Armament Systems, based in Burlington, Vt., is primarily a supplier of gun systems.
